notes.title: One week left till the release of House of Jigsaw: Masters of Art
notes.notes:
We're beyond excited to announce the upcoming launch of our new game House of Jigsaw: Masters of Art! 

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39580520/994fbf343b8dbcf5354b0dbc1f6c583701b3b2da.jpg

Be among the first to experience all major art styles in more than 100 high quality puzzles. Enjoy the modern UI and 4 difficulty levels (30/120/300/600 pieces) in just one week. 

Get ready to jump into the puzzles in a world of stunning visuals. Can't wait to see you then, wishlist now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2197960/House_of_Jigsaw_Masters_of_Art/
